title: EOI - Engineering Professionals (Civil/Structural Drafter / early career) - AUS
location: Australia-wide (Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne, Sydney, Darwin, Perth)
content_text:
EOI - Engineering Professionals - AUS. Posted 10/12/2024. Closing Date 31/12/2026.
GPA Engineering is looking for enthusiastic engineering professionals across Australian offices. Early-career or seasoned. Disciplines include Civil/Structural and Drafters (Mechanical / Electrical / Civil / Structural) and Technical Officers.
Essential: tertiary qualification in engineering or related discipline; Industry experience in one or more of GPA's key sectors; strong technical/analytical skills; communication and teamwork.
How to Apply: Applications must be submitted via the online recruitment system. Queries: HR@gpaeng.com.au.
Offices: Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne, Sydney, Darwin and Perth. Sectors: oil & gas, defence, water, mining & minerals, power, renewable energy and hydrogen.
apply_instructions: Apply via ElmoTalent EOI portal https://gpaeng.elmotalent.com.au/careers/career/job/view/105. Queries HR@gpaeng.com.au. Closes 31 Dec 2026.
